items.title: Scott Jimmy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: every time I was in the Apollo, Johnnie Ray would be sitting there.

ctx.x: [sings:] “If your sweetheart sends a letter goodbye . .” – when you heard these – he was obviously modeled on you, and later he would tell that to everybody – but when you would hear Johnnie Ray on the radio sing Cry or The Little [White] Cloud that Cried, whatever those songs were, did you ever feel like, God, that’s me, that’s my style? Or that’s not in your nature either?
I never thought about it. But Johnnie Ray, every time I was in the Apollo, Johnnie Ray would be sitting there.
